scores.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete work-in-progress that only implements schema compilation at registration time and never actually calls the validator inside `ToolRegistry.execute`. As a result, three of the four tests it adds in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` fail immediately, and unused `validateInput` / default `import Ajv from 'ajv'` likely fail linting/typechecking under ESM `NodeNext`. It also compiles function-valued tool definitions at `register` time rather than resolving and caching them per call in a `WeakMap` during `execute`. Nearly all required unit tests, documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`), and the `execute` JSDoc comment are missing, while an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file was left in the diff.
